Tooltip_HCR_MilkCoffee: Mug: 0.1 L coffee + 0.1 L milk. Thermos: 0.7 L of each. Requires a separate empty vessel; leftovers stay in their original containers. Nutrition, freshness and contaminants follow both ingredients.
Tooltip_HCR_CoffeeBrew: Requires an empty mug and 0.2 L of clean water from another vessel, or 1.5 L for a kettle. Brew over heat, then finish preparation.
Tooltip_HCR_CoffeePour: Pour 0.2 L of brewed coffee into an empty mug, or 1.4 L into a thermos. The remainder and drink properties are retained.
Tooltip_HCR_CoffeeSugar: Add sugar to 0.2 L of coffee in a mug or 1.4 L in a thermos. The vessel, nutrition, freshness and contaminants from both ingredients are retained.
Tooltip_HCR_FinishSoy: Cook the soy milk over heat first. Finishing makes it pourable, retaining the remainder, nutrition, freshness, contaminants and burning. No extra empty bottle is created.
Tooltip_HCR_PackBeer: Six full original cans of the same brand. Partly used, refilled or altered drinks cannot be packed.
Tooltip_HCR_CookingBeer: Measure 0.3 L of Hydrocraft beer into an empty stein for soup or stew. Nutrition, freshness, poison and alcohol effects are retained.
Tooltip_HCR_CookingHerbalSpirit: Measure 0.8 L of absinthe or herbal liqueur into an empty bottle for cooking. The remainder, nutrition, freshness and poison are retained.
Tooltip_HCR_LegacyAguardiente: Drink as it is or use in Monkey Tail. Legacy stock with no hunger value cannot be added to soups, stews or hot drinks.
Tooltip_HCR_MixerYield: Yield: 0.1 L of mixer from 0.1 L of juice. Nutrition, freshness and contaminants follow the ingredients. The bottle remains partly full.
Tooltip_HCR_PackPop: Six full original cans. Partly used, refilled or altered drinks cannot be packed.
Tooltip_HCR_FitnessMix: Yield: 1.4 L in the same empty canteen. Keeps the original recipe nutrition; freshness and contaminants follow the ingredients. Uses one blender battery charge.
Tooltip_HCR_CocktailYield: Volume and properties follow the ingredients used. Liquids left in the source containers are retained; freshness and contaminants carry into the drink.
Tooltip_HCR_MilkCocktailBatch: Eggnog yields 0.35 L; Monkey Tail yields 1.1 L. Four mugs require 0.8 L; two bottles require 2 L. Liquid may come from several containers; unused liquid and source vessels are retained.

Tooltip_HCR_MashFerment: Combine 1.5 L of cooked mash and 18.5 L of clean water in an empty 20 L cask. Fermentation takes 14 days. Pots and cask are retained; freshness and contaminants follow the ingredients.
